sources.entry: Obsidian plugins & themes - Community plugins list, theme list, and releases of Obsidian.

summary.one_liner: Public release and directory repo for Obsidian, hosting the community plugin and theme listings and submission policies, though not Obsidian's source code.
summary.what_it_does: The README states that this repo hosts public Obsidian releases and the community plugin and theme directories. It explicitly says Obsidian is not open source and the repo does not contain Obsidian's source code. It describes how Obsidian reads the plugin list from community-plugins.json, fetches manifest.json and README.md for detail pages, and installs plugin files (manifest.json, main.js, styles.css) from GitHub releases tagged to the manifest version. It also covers versions.json fallback for older Obsidian versions and how developers announce a first release or run a beta via BRAT. The repo does not accept issues; those go to individual plugin repos or the Obsidian community.
use_cases: submit an Obsidian community plugin to the directory
submit an Obsidian theme to the directory
understand how Obsidian installs community plugins from GitHub releases
check plugin release and versions.json compatibility rules
announce a beta plugin to testers
notable: Serves as the official community plugin and theme directory data for Obsidian
Plugins install from GitHub releases matched to the manifest.json version
versions.json lets older Obsidian versions get a compatible plugin release
Documents the BRAT plugin as a way to run beta tests
Does not accept issues; questions go to plugin repos or the community forum
caveats: Does not contain Obsidian's source code and Obsidian is not open source
Does not accept issues; bug reports must go to individual plugin repos or the community
